premises.text: Using large public clouds requires costly DevOps to manage servers; hosting apps means tedious, error-prone VM, networking, and SSL setup
premises.evidence_span: Every year, businesses spend billions of dollars in engineering costs just to manage servers on AWS

premises.text: Render is a fully automated cloud: push to Git and it builds, deploys, secures, scales, load-balances, and alerts without managing servers
premises.evidence_span: Render is a completely automated cloud provider. Render lets you deploy anything from a simple static site to complex application clusters

premises.text: Built-in service discovery, private networking, load balancing, managed SSDs with backups/restores, and infra defined in one Git-pushed file
premises.evidence_span: every Render service gets built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing

premises.text: Render combines Heroku-like ease with more flexibility and much lower price than stagnated managed clouds
premises.evidence_span: Just two gigabytes of RAM costs $250 a month on Heroku compared to $25 a month on Render

value.text: Deploy and host apps faster without managing servers, saving engineering cost
value.evidence_span: you can do it faster than on any other cloud and without managing servers at all

secondary_value.text: Best of both worlds: amazing ease of use with tremendous flexibility
secondary_value.evidence_span: Amazing ease of use combined with tremendous flexibility

causal_links.evidence_span: Simply push your code to Git. We automate everything from there
looking to save big on engineering costs, automate your cloud hosting

notes: Three launch innovations folded into automated-cloud premise per §4.1(5) with price/positioning as separate commercial module. Stripe bio and MoM revenue traction excluded. PaaS/IaaS market-size vision not coded as premises.
